unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U21: Distinguish prospectus,red-herring and shelf disclosure routes

payload.title: Look at the invitation substance
payload.core_explanation_md:
The prospectus concept extends beyond a document carrying that heading to the described public securities invitation. A red-herring prospectus omits complete particulars of quantum or price; that does not remove disclosure obligations. The source states filing at least three days before the offer/subscription opening and later disclosure of the completed offer particulars.

A shelf prospectus supports the specified multiple-issue route over a period; it is not permanent permission to omit material changes. Private-company restrictions on public invitations remain relevant. Rights issues, underwriting, private placement and public offers must be classified under their own provisions rather than using the textbook exception list as a universal disclosure waiver.

self_check.prompt_text: Does missing final price mean a red-herring document has no prospectus obligations?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The source expressly preserves the applicable obligations.

payload.stem_md: An issuer calls a public securities invitation a newsletter and assumes prospectus rules cannot apply. What matters?

options.explanation_md: The concept is broader than a heading.
That does not decide the invitation nature.

options.text_md: The substance of the invitation and applicable securities route
options.explanation_md: A label alone does not avoid the framework.
Printing source does not settle classification.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A label alone does not avoid the framework.

payload.stem_md: A red-herring document omits final price and the issuer therefore omits all material disclosure. What is wrong?

options.text_md: Incomplete price particulars do not remove the applicable prospectus obligations
Red-herring documents must contain no information
options.explanation_md: The incomplete price or quantum feature does not remove the document applicable disclosure obligations.

options.text_md: Every offer is automatically private placement
A later price always cures every misleading omission
